MorphoVault_kpkEURC_V1.$comment: kpk EURC vault (MetaMorpho ERC4626). Superseded by MorphoVaultsMeta (ADR 0010); vault still queried via instances.

ERC4626Wrap_sGHO.$comment: Aave sGHO savings vault (ERC-4626). sGHO.asset() returns GHO; convertToAssets unwraps shares to GHO-equivalent. Held by the Alpha funds. At fork block 25230126, redeem() returned exactly convertToAssets() (no exit fee/cooldown), so convertToAssets does not over-report. Share price is >= 1 GHO (yield vault), not a 1:1 share/asset peg.

ERC4626Wrap_RWIV.$comment: DISABLED — superseded by the RWIV custom price feed (RWIV_PriceOracle). RWIV is now a registered priced asset (assets-and-price-feeds/1.json), and registerAsset auto-adds it to the ERC20DefaultAdapter inclusion list, so the wallet adapter already reports the direct RWIV holding at RWIV/USD (same convertToAssets value this wrap produced as USDC). Keeping this wrap enabled would DOUBLE-COUNT the Nexus Safe's ~$250k direct RWIV. The price feed was required anyway so UniswapV3PoolsMeta can value the USDC/RWIV LP (pool 0x764D5075). See PR feat/rwiv-price-feed-univ3.

ERC4626Wrap_waEthLidoGHO.$comment: Aave V3 Lido instance stata-token wrap of aEthLidoGHO. waEthLidoGHO.asset() returns GHO; convertToAssets unwraps shares to GHO-equivalent. ACCOUNT_11 holds ~$233 of this token. Production adapter not deployed yet — integration test deploys it ephemerally from this config block. Run script/deploy/04_DeployBalanceAdapters.s.sol post-PR-merge to deploy and write the address back into `deployed`.

EtherFiWithdrawals.$comment: ether.fi withdrawal-queue cache adapter (ADR 0014). Registered via addBalanceAdapters; reports 0 until the kpk-agents submitter feeds tokenIds.

StakeWiseExitQueue.$comment: StakeWise V3 exit-queue cache adapter (ADR 0014). Registered via addBalanceAdapters; reports 0 until the kpk-agents submitter feeds (vault, positionTicket, timestamp) tuples.
